lines.text: Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way! Oh what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleigh!
How does a heavy wooden sleigh glide smoothly across soft snow without sinking in?
If you used thin bike wheels, the heavy weight would sink right into the snowbank!
But sleigh runners are long, smooth, and gently curved upward at the front!
They spread the weight across the snow so the sleigh floats on top of the powder!
As the runner slides, tiny friction melts a microscopic film of slippery water!
The sleigh hydroplanes across the snow like a speedboat across a lake!
Now you know the winter engineering behind Jingle Bells!
